objective: Teach learners to decide whether lab access is allowed using only the supplied rules.
rule_summary: Access is allowed when badge_valid=true and training_complete=true.
badge_valid=false determines that access is denied.
A missing required fact makes the decision undetermined.
badge_valid=true with training_complete=false has no supplied outcome and is therefore undetermined.
overlap_diagnosis: E1 and E2 have identical predicate signatures and decisions; retain E1 and consolidate E2.

examples.rule_applied: Both stated sufficient conditions are true.
examples.learner_task: Decide whether lab access is allowed.
examples.meaningful_difference: Baseline retained case; repetitive E2 is consolidated.
